notes.text: The heading abbreviates the title before Chuna of Tzippori; the pointer ר"ה is conventionally read here as Huna, but its title can mean Rav or Rabbi. The place and name do not settle that expansion. R-prime preserves the unresolved title; no destination identity is established.
